description: Token monitoring for trading agents: re-checks a token on-chain and reports only what changed since your last call: grade downgrade (A to F), honeypot or sell tax appearing, new risk flags (mint, blacklist, owner powers), price and liquidity moves above your threshold (liquidity pulls, rug signals) and holder concentration shifts, with an alert_level (none, medium, high). Same checks as token-verdict and token-security, computed by us on the blockchain. First call saves a baseline and returns a cursor; pass it on the next call. Chains: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, solana. Params: token, chain (default base, solana auto-detected), price_move_pct (default 10), cursor. Price: $0.008 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"token":"0x532f27101965dd16442E59d40670FaF5eBB142E4","chain":"base"}.

cursor.description: Cursor from your previous call; omit on the first call

price_move_pct.description: Report price and liquidity moves of at least this percentage (minimum 1)

token.description: Token contract address (0x...) or Solana mint

name: token_watch
title: Token Risk and Price Monitor (alerts on change)
